title: Should You Buy Comcast Stock Because Its Cash Outruns Its Earnings?
summary: Comcast (CMCSA) has lost 19.2% over the past year, while the S&P 500 returned 18.5%, and the reason given is usually broadband: 167,000 subscribers gone in the June quarter.
